![](../../examples/assets/estimate.svg){width="300" fig-alt="A synthetic estimate on a slide that opts out of stretching"}

::: {.aside}
The slide-level opt-out wins too.
:::

## Captioned sizing opt-out {#fixed-caption-aside}

![The caption stays attached to the small figure](../../examples/assets/estimate.svg){.nostretch width="300" fig-alt="A small captioned synthetic estimate"}

::: {.aside}
Caption wrappers must not opt fixed images into layout-fill.
:::

## Canvas and decorative content {#canvas-content}

```{=html}
<span id="decorative-mark" aria-hidden="true">*</span>
<canvas id="sample-chart" width="100" height="50" role="img" aria-label="A solid burgundy rectangle"></canvas>
<script>document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => { const context = document.getElementById("sample-chart").getContext("2d"); context.fillStyle = "#62273b"; context.fillRect(0, 0, 100, 50); });</script>
```
